Provides utility functions and patterns for common string operations used across the codebase.

## Key Components

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `CveIDPattern` | `*regexp.Regexp` | Compiled regex matching CVE identifiers in the format `CVE-YYYY-NNNN+` |
| `UniqueStrings` | `func` | Deduplicates a string slice, returning `nil` for empty input |

## Usage Example

```go
// Match CVE IDs from text
text := "Affected by CVE-2024-12345 and CVE-2023-9999"
matches := util.CveIDPattern.FindAllString(text, -1)
// matches: ["CVE-2024-12345", "CVE-2023-9999"]

// Deduplicate a string slice
tags := []string{"linux", "critical", "linux", "windows", "critical"}
unique := util.UniqueStrings(tags)
// unique: ["linux", "critical", "windows"] (order not guaranteed)
```

> **Note:** `UniqueStrings` uses a map internally, so the order of elements in the returned slice is non-deterministic. Sort the result if order matters.
